description: Adds one piece of software the website runs, by name (Debian, nginx, WordPress, Next.js…), package (npm:lodash, composer:vendor/package, pypi:django, wp-plugin:slug) or NVD product (cpe:vendor:product), with its version if known. Replaces a detected or imported entry for the same product. Free.

name.description: Product name or package, such as "Debian" or "npm:lodash".

version.description: Installed version, such as 12 or 4.17.21. Leave out when unknown.

name: add_software
title: Add software to a monitor
